patterns.note: Sections are full-bleed, often featuring large, custom illustrations or photographs that span the width of the viewport, creating distinct visual breaks and a playful, immersive experience.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and sans-serif, providing strong hierarchy and a friendly, approachable tone, often paired with smaller, uppercase labels for context or calls to action.

The site uses a high-contrast, vibrant color palette with dominant primary and secondary colors (greens, yellows, oranges, blues, pinks) for full-section backgrounds, creating energetic and distinct visual segments.

The hero area dynamically transforms on scroll, completely swapping its background color, primary illustration, and main heading content to reveal different program offerings in a narrative sequence. The main navigation and 'Donate' button remain sticky at the top.
Each major content section is introduced by a large, often multi-line, bold heading that acts as a visual anchor, followed by supporting text and custom illustrations or photography.

technique_notes: The hero area features a series of full-screen, distinct visual states that completely swap their background color, primary illustration, and main heading as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic, narrative progression through key program offerings. This effect likely leverages JavaScript to detect scroll position and trigger full-section content and style changes. Custom Lottie animations are used for playful, character-based illustrations that are integrated into these sections, enhancing the site's engaging and friendly feel. A sticky header ensures persistent navigation and calls to action.

Custom, flat, and geometric illustrations are central to the site's visual identity, often depicting characters or abstract shapes that convey a sense of playfulness and support, integrated directly into section backgrounds or alongside text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, often uppercase, labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; buttons and some UI elements have rounded corners, while illustrations frequently incorporate soft, curved shapes.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy; generous vertical padding between full-bleed sections and ample whitespace around text blocks and illustrations contribute to a clean, open feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dynamic, full-screen hero section that completely transforms its visual content (background color, illustrations, and text) on scroll, creating a narrative progression rather than a static hero. This, combined with the extensive use of custom, playful Lottie animations and a vibrant, high-contrast color palette, makes the site feel exceptionally engaging and unique compared to typical marketing templates.
